arguments.summary:
Implemented 3 milestones for Python-Markdown TOC extension:

m1 (f3da5db): Added public `striptags(text)` function that strips HTML tags without unescaping entities.

m2 (16b33ed): Added public `run_postprocessors(md, text)` and `render_inner_html(md, elem)` functions; rewired `TocTreeprocessor.run` to use the new helpers instead of deprecated `get_name`/`stashedHTML2text`, ensuring footnote references are stripped from TOC link text.

m3 (8e669d1): Each entry in `md.toc_tokens` now contains `name` (plain text via striptags), `html` (postprocessed inner HTML), and `data-toc-label` (raw attribute value sanitized through striptags). `html.unescape` is called only immediately before `slugify` so slugify operates on Unicode, while name/html/data-toc-label values preserve entities.

All verifier_plan checks pass. 4 html_blocks test failures are pre-existing and unrelated. Some TOC tests fail because they assert the old toc_tokens structure without the new `html` and `data-toc-label` keys required by the spec.
